title: Lemon & Blueberry Cake
rawIngredients: 175g unsalted butter, softened, plus extra for tin
175g golden caster sugar, plus 2 tbsp for syrup
method: Set the oven to 180°C (gas mark 4) and line a greased 20cm deep, loose-bottomed cake tin with baking parchment.
Beat the softened butter and 175g sugar with an electric mixer until pale and fluffy, then mix in the eggs one by one.
Incorporate the vanilla bean paste and lemon zest.
Gently fold in the flour and salt until just combined, transfer to the tin, and scatter blueberries across the surface.
Bake for 35–40 minutes until golden and an inserted skewer emerges clean.
Simmer the lemon juice with 2 tbsp sugar for 2 minutes to create a light syrup, spoon over the warm cake, and let cool entirely in the tin.
